narrative.overview: Studio Babui is presented as an issue of an independent fashion publication. Each scroll is a spread: a photograph placed off-centre on a calm ivory field, with Bodoni type working as a second image. Whitespace is the material, not leftover space. Interface chrome (navigation, captions, controls) stays tiny, tracked and quiet so the photographs and the headlines carry the page.
keyCharacteristics: Ivory field, ink type, sand behind every photograph while it loads.
Oversized Bodoni display set against 11px tracked DM Sans capitals.
Asymmetric 12-column spreads; no two sections share a composition.
Square corners, hairline rules, no shadows, no cards.
Every animation is off under prefers-reduced-motion; content is visible without JavaScript.

rules.name: The Small Text Rule
rules.body: Text under 18px on ivory uses graphite, never stone; stone fails contrast at small sizes.

rules.name: The No Fill Rule
rules.body: Umber marks; it never fills a region.

rules.name: The Italic Turn Rule
rules.body: A display line may switch to italic for its last phrase. Never italicise a whole headline.

rules.name: The Masked Line Rule
rules.body: Any display text that animates is revealed line by line from a mask with padding below the baseline, so descenders never clip.

rules.name: The One Sideways Rule
rules.body: Only Featured Pieces moves horizontally, and only on desktop with motion allowed.

dos: Do let one photograph lead each spread, and give it the most space.
Do put metadata in the margins and captions (label type, graphite), never stacked above a headline.
Do reveal photographs with the clip-path wipe and display type with masked lines, using withMotion and the presets in src/lib/animations.ts.
Do keep content visible by default; animations only start from hidden once GSAP has taken over.
Do label sample data as sample, and say plainly when something isn't connected yet.
donts: Don't use cards, shadows, rounded corners, gradients or glass.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.
Don't use stone for text under 18px on ivory.
Don't add a second horizontal or pinned sequence.
Don't invent brand history, artisan, manufacturing or sustainability claims.
